name: MonarchDescriptionList
title: DescriptionList
summary: Key and value facts of a record (owner, stage, created), stacked or inline, in one or more columns, with optional copy buttons, line limits and a "Not set" dash for empty values.
whenToUse: On detail screens, for the facts of a record people read rather than edit.
whenNotToUse: For editable values use form fields. For data people compare across many records use a table or list. For one fact in running text, write it out.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDescriptionList(items: List<MonarchDescriptionItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, layout: MonarchDescriptionListLayout = MonarchDescriptionListLayout.Stacked, columns: Int = 1, copyIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, emptyLabel: String? = null, showMoreLabel: String? = null, showLessLabel: String? = null)

class MonarchDescriptionItem(term: String, value: String?, copyable: Boolean = false, copyValue: String? = null, maxLines: Int? = null, wide: Boolean = false, content: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The facts: term, value text, copy options, line limit, wide flag and an optional content slot such as a badge.

options.name: layout
options.description: Stacked puts the term above the value; Inline puts them side by side and stacks when the list is narrower than 288dp or the font scale is 1.5 or more.

options.name: columns
options.description: How many items share a row from 640dp wide; below that every item takes its own row. Wide items always take a whole row.

options.name: copyIcon
options.description: A copy icon; given, copy buttons are icon buttons, otherwise small ghost text buttons.

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken text of an empty value, "Not set" (monarch_descriptionlist_empty).

options.name: showMoreLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Show more" of values with a line limit (MonarchTruncatedText).

options.name: showLessLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Show less" of values with a line limit.

states.name: stacked
states.description: The term in the muted caption style above the value in the body style.

states.name: inline
states.description: The term at the start in two fifths of the row and the value beside it.

states.name: empty
states.description: A dash in the subtle text color, read as "Not set"; no copy button.

states.name: truncated
states.description: The value cut at maxLines with a Show more button that expands it.

appearance: Terms in the caption style and the muted text color, values in the body style and the default text color, an empty value's dash in the subtle text color. Copy buttons are ghost MonarchCopyButtons. No borders or fills. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: iOS styles the system LabeledContent (MonarchLabeledContentStyle) and composes copy, truncation and columns; Compose has no labelled-content component, so Android ships MonarchDescriptionList with those options built in, as the web does. The web DescriptionList and DescriptionItem are a list and children; here the items are data (MonarchDescriptionItem) with a content slot for anything that is not plain text. The web's copyable true or string is copyable and copyValue. The web's truncate number is maxLines, using MonarchTruncatedText. The web's placeholder node is not offered: an empty value is always the dash with emptyLabel. The web's auto column count is not offered; columns is a number. The web uses an extra-small icon copy button; Android has no extra-small size on touch, so the copy button is the Sm ghost text button or, with copyIcon, an icon button with a 48dp target. The web's 420px inline breakpoint is 288dp here, and inline also stacks from font scale 1.5.
accessibility: Each item is one TalkBack element read as the term and then the value.
An empty value is shown as a dash and read as "Not set".
A copy button is a separate element named "Copy" and the term, with a touch target of at least 48dp; it copies the value or copyValue.
A Show more button of a truncated value is a separate element with a 48dp target.
In the inline layout the term is before the value in both layout directions; at font scale 2.0 the list is stacked and nothing is cut.
edgeCases: An item with content but no value has no copy button unless it has copyValue.
An empty string counts as empty.
A row that is not full keeps its columns aligned with empty space at the end.
Columns are decided from the width the list is given, not the window.

examples.title: Record facts
examples.template:
MonarchDescriptionList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchDescriptionItem({{items.0.term}}, {{items.0.value}}),
        MonarchDescriptionItem({{items.1.term}}, {{items.1.value}}),
        MonarchDescriptionItem({{items.2.term}}, {{items.2.value}}),
        MonarchDescriptionItem({{items.3.term}}, {{items.3.value}}),
        MonarchDescriptionItem({{items.4.term}}, {{items.4.value}}, wide = {{items.4.wide}}),
    ),
    columns = {{columns}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchDescriptionList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Owner", "Ada Lovelace"),
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Stage", "Proposal"),
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Created", "3 March"),
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Source", "Inbound"),
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Notes", "Follow up after the product review.", wide = true),
    ),
    columns = 2,
)

examples.title: Inline, two columns on wide screens
examples.code:
MonarchDescriptionList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Plan", "Team"),
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Seats", "12 of 50"),
        MonarchDescriptionItem("Notes", "Renews in March after the finance review.", maxLines = 1, wide = true),
    ),
    layout = MonarchDescriptionListLayout.Inline,
    columns = 2,
)
